title: Coast Guard Crews Respond to Boat Fire North of Protection Island, Wash.
description:
A 45-Foot Response Boat-Medium crew from Coast Guard Station Port Angeles meets with a good Samaritan vessel near Protection Island, Wash., June 11, 2018.

A 40-ft recreational vessel with three people aboard had caught fire in the area and the good Sam pulled them from the water after they abandoned ship in survival suits. 

U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station/Sector Field Office Port Angeles.
